sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
This poster is a reference to the 5th season of Escape from Tarkov ARG. Players had to find it in Germany at 49.896700, 8.519230 (49°53'48.1"N 8°31'09.2"E) and use the information from it to progress the ARG further.

The QR code leads to a Google Drive named "Schiller" published by "kermen@tarkov.com". The text below the QR code lists the address of the same Google Drive. The Drive contains a single file "Tree stump" with the coordinates 51.4694559, 7.2249327. Those point to a park in Bochum, Germany, where players found further information for ARG.
